args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 (latest deploy) was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an error rate of ~18%. The prior release candidate v2.3.1-rc was also unhealthy. Rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0, the most recent healthy release, in all regions; rollback verified as rolled out in us-east, us-west, and eu-west. Follow-up: confirm health/error rate recovery and investigate root cause in v2.3.1 before redeploying.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all three regions, and it's healthy again. I also opened the SEV2 incident.

- **What was wrong:** v2.3.1, the latest deploy, was running in us-east, us-west and eu-west, failing health checks with an 18% error rate.
- **Why v2.3.0:** The deploy history isn't listed in order. Sorting by sequence number, the two most recent releases (v2.3.1-rc and v2.3.1) were both unhealthy, which makes v2.3.0 the last healthy one.
- **After the rollback:** All three regions are on v2.3.0, the service reports healthy, and the error rate is 0.2%.
- **Incident INC-0001 (SEV2, checkout-api):** It's open and on-call has been paged. It describes the failure, the rollback and the follow-up: watch that it stays recovered and find the root cause in v2.3.1 before redeploying.

content.text: Most recent healthy release by sequence is v2.3.0 (v2.3.1-rc and v2.3.1 are both unhealthy).
